spec.description: Where and when València's public bikes fail their riders, over the last week, from the city's open data on a FIWARE platform (Stellio, NGSI-LD): each station on a map from no bike (red) to no dock (blue), the day hour by hour, the stations most often empty or full, and a timeline of the week, all filtering each other in the browser.

options.content:
### About the data

**Valenbisi**, València's public bikes: about 275 stations, each read about every 7 minutes from the Ajuntament de
València's open data by a harvester that writes them as **Smart Data Models** (`BikeHireDockingStation`) to **Stellio**,
an **NGSI-LD** context broker of the **FIWARE** catalogue. Stellio keeps every observation; a Parquet export holds the
last 7 days ([exports](https://fiware.ubica.dev/exports/)). The same platform feeds
[València en tiempo real](/d/fiware-valencia).

**How it is counted.** DuckDB on the server reads the export and keeps each station's last reading in each quarter hour;
DuckDB in your browser (Chaski) answers every panel and every filter from that table. A quarter hour with 0 bikes counts
0.25 h of *no bike*; one with 0 free docks, 0.25 h of *no dock*. A quarter hour with no reading (a few hundred station
hours in a week) has no row and counts as neither. A station's colour on the map is its share of the time with no dock
minus its share with no bike, in points. The hour of the day is València's. LABMAD, a test station in Madrid, is left out.

<small>Data: © Ajuntament de València, open data Geoportal, CC BY 4.0. An independent proof of concept, not affiliated
with the Ajuntament de València. Base map © OpenStreetMap contributors, © CARTO.</small>

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::DOUBLE AS "Stations" FROM (SELECT station FROM $docks WHERE $__crossfilter($dockFilters) GROUP BY station HAVING sum(no_bike_h) >= 24)

spec.description: Stations that added up 24 hours or more with no bike, in what the filters keep.
spec.title: A day or more with no bike

spec.rawSql:
-- Each station over the hours and days the filters keep: the share of the time with no bike and with no dock,
-- their hours, and its lean (no dock minus no bike, in points). The area drawn on this map is left out here, so
-- the map keeps every station while the rest of the dashboard keeps the area's.
SELECT station, name, latitude, longitude, max(slots) AS slots,
       round(100 * avg(no_bike), 1) AS no_bike_pct, round(100 * avg(no_dock), 1) AS no_dock_pct,
       round(100 * (avg(no_dock) - avg(no_bike)), 1) AS lean,
       sum(no_bike_h) AS hours_no_bike, sum(no_dock_h) AS hours_no_dock
FROM $docks
WHERE $__crossfilter($dockFilters, -area)
GROUP BY station, name, latitude, longitude

-- The cards: the six stations with the most hours with no bike and the six with the most with no dock, in what
-- the filters keep, each with its series hour by hour over the days kept (all hours of the day, so the line is
-- whole): the share of its docks that held a bike, 0 empty and 100 full.
WITH f AS (SELECT * FROM $docks WHERE $__crossfilter($dockFilters, -area)),
top AS (
  (SELECT station FROM f GROUP BY station ORDER BY sum(no_bike_h) DESC, station LIMIT 6)
  UNION
  (SELECT station FROM f GROUP BY station ORDER BY sum(no_dock_h) DESC, station LIMIT 6)
)
SELECT d.station, any_value(d.short) AS name, any_value(d.latitude) AS latitude, any_value(d.longitude) AS longitude,
       time_bucket(INTERVAL 1 HOUR, d.t) AS time,
       round(100 * avg(d.bikes / nullif(d.slots, 0)))::INTEGER AS value
FROM $docks AS d JOIN top USING (station)
WHERE $__crossfilter($dockFilters, -area, -hour)
GROUP BY d.station, time
ORDER BY d.station, time

options.content:
## Valenbisi's NULLs

A public bike system fails a rider in two ways: **no bike** to take, or **no dock** to leave one in. Both are a zero in the
city's feed, a NULL in the trip that never happens.

In the week to 18 November 2026, a València station had no bike **12 % of the time** and no dock **6 %**. 93 of 275
stations added up a whole day or more with no bike; among the driest were the old town's squares (Plaza de la Reina,
the Ajuntament's) and Ribera. Towards the sea it is the other way round: between 1 and 5 at night, a station there had
no free dock a quarter of the time, full of the bikes left there the evening before.

**Use it:** drag across hours on *The day of a NULL*, or days on *The week*; draw an area on the map. Every panel follows,
in your browser. The cards show the week the platform holds now.

query.rawSql:
-- Server side: Valenbisi's history (Stellio -> Parquet, the FIWARE platform's export of the last 7 days), the
-- last reading of each station in each quarter hour. A station is NULL when it has no bike to take (no_bike) or no
-- dock to leave one in (no_dock); each quarter hour counts 0.25 h. The hour of the day is València's. LABMAD, a test
-- station in Madrid, is left out by the box. A quarter hour with no reading has no row.
SELECT t, hour(timezone('Europe/Madrid', t)) AS hr, station,
       station || ' · ' || replace(regexp_replace(raw_name, '^[0-9]+_ ?', ''), '_', ' ') AS name,
       left(station || ' · ' || replace(regexp_replace(raw_name, '^[0-9]+_ ?', ''), '_', ' '), 34) AS short,
       latitude, longitude, slots, bikes, free,
       (bikes = 0)::INTEGER AS no_bike, (free = 0)::INTEGER AS no_dock,
       CASE WHEN bikes = 0 THEN 0.25 ELSE 0 END AS no_bike_h,
       CASE WHEN free = 0 THEN 0.25 ELSE 0 END AS no_dock_h
FROM (
  SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL 15 MINUTE, time) AS t,
         regexp_extract(entity_id, '[0-9]+$') AS station,
         last(name ORDER BY time) AS raw_name,
         last(available_bikes ORDER BY time) AS bikes,
         last(free_slots ORDER BY time) AS free,
         last(total_slots ORDER BY time) AS slots,
         any_value(latitude) AS latitude, any_value(longitude) AS longitude
  FROM read_parquet('https://fiware.ubica.dev/exports/bikes.parquet')
  WHERE latitude BETWEEN 39.3 AND 39.6 AND longitude BETWEEN -0.5 AND -0.25
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
